title: Senior/Lead Software Engineer
description:
Lead / Senior Software Engineer / DV Clearable / 5 Days Onsite


Location: London

We're seeking experienced Lead and Senior Software Engineers to join a high-performing engineering team delivering modern, secure and scalable software solutions. This is an opportunity to work on complex technology challenges, contribute to large-scale modernisation programmes, and help drive the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices within highly regulated environments.

The Role


As a Lead or Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing, building and delivering high-quality software systems that balance performance, security and maintainability. Working closely with product, security and operational teams, you'll help shape technical solutions while contributing to a culture of engineering excellence.
You'll be involved in the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through to deployment and operational support, ensuring solutions are scalable, resilient and fit for purpose.
Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and developing secure, scalable and maintainable software solutions
  • Translating business requirements into robust technical designs
  • Contributing to software and system architecture decisions
  • Building and supporting high-performing CI/CD pipelines and engineering practices
  • Applying modern development standards, clean code principles and secure-by-design approaches
  • Supporting testing, quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Collaborating with product managers, designers, security teams and engineers to deliver business outcomes
  • Contributing to the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities within software products
What We're Looking ForEssential Experience
  • Proven experience across the full software development lifecycle
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, API development and data modelling
  • Experience developing clean, maintainable and testable code
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices and development standards
  • Experience working within highly regulated, complex or large-scale environments
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience using AI tools within the software development process
  • Minimum three years' commercial software engineering experience
Desirable Experience
  • AI/ML engineering, MLOps, LLMOps or agentic workflow experience
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of GitOps practices and modern deployment methodologies
  • Experience with secrets management technologies such as Vault or AWS Secrets Manager
  • Public sector or large financial services experience
  • For Lead-level candidates, experience mentoring engineers and leading technical teams
The Ideal Candidate


We're looking for adaptable technologists with a passion for modern software engineering. You'll enjoy solving complex problems, working across disciplines, embracing emerging technologies and delivering practical solutions that create tangible business value.
You'll be equally comfortable contributing hands-on technical expertise, influencing engineering decisions and collaborating with stakeholders to drive successful outcomes.

What's On Offer
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge software engineering and AI initiatives
  • Exposure to modern development practices, cloud-native technologies and emerging AI capabilities
  • Challenging projects with real-world impact
  • Collaborative and inclusive engineering culture
  • Strong focus on continuous learning and technical development
  • Opportunity to influence architecture, engineering standards and future technology direction


Apply today to discuss this opportunity in more detail.

Guidant, Carbon60, Lorien & SRG - The Vertage Group Portfolio are acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
